subject: science
concept: Understanding acids, bases, and pH at a conceptual level
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Chemical Reactions) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tests real or simulated household substances with pH indicator paper and records results
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a pH value to whether the substance is acidic, neutral, or basic
exercise.abstract: Student classifies a described substance as acidic, neutral, or basic based on its pH

misconception_flags: believes a higher pH number always means a stronger substance regardless of acid/base direction

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
